title: The Effects of High Dose Fish Oil Supplementation on Delayed Onset Muscle Soreness and Inflammatory Markers

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to determine the effects of fish oil supplementation (Lovaza, GlaxoSmithKline) on muscle strength, muscle soreness and inflammation following exercise.

Posted outcomes: Quadriceps Muscle Strength. timeframe=6 days. Fish Oil=151 (±6); Control=160 (±8). p=>0.05
